decisions.reason: The linking behavior is established by a separate clause in the same message and is already represented; reducing vertical spacing does not change that behavior.
The missing first-section control is a separate coverage failure already represented in this Requirement; the spacing change does not alter required coverage.
Bringing the controls closer together changes placement spacing, not the existing wrapper or visual-style requirements.
The Q&A box removal is unrelated to secondary-control spacing.
The spacing change does not necessarily alter the required duplicate artifact or its stated duplication timing.
Secondary-control spacing does not affect whether the duplicate page includes a pricing section.
The source change concerns spacing between navigation controls and does not change monthly-marker typography.
The secondary-control spacing change does not alter pricing-panel count or pricing-section layout rules.
The desktop YouTube control is a different navigation element whose placement remains unchanged.
The source changes spacing for the course-content jump control, not mobile visibility of the YouTube control.
Spacing between secondary and primary controls does not affect the pricing subheader's alignment or placement.
The bonus-section removal and its unresolved page scope are unrelated to secondary-control spacing.
